purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system and handles a test-print screen (W62) for the system management subsystem. It initialises the screen, reads printer configuration from system management master tables (codes 1031, 2005), builds a printer list, and manages blob import of a test PostScript file for preview/print testing.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical association receipt software)

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY books (30+ copybooks) for screen areas, DB layouts, and subprogram interfaces
CALL to 'MONFUNC' with MCPAREA — ORCA framework MCP (Message Control Program) interface
BLOB import via MCP-FUNC 'BLOBIMPORT' for PostScript test file
LINKAGE SECTION receives MCPAREA, SPAAREA, LINKAREA, SCRAREA — typical ORCA screen program signature
Japanese text in comments (encoded as latin-1 / EUC-JP)

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in EUC-JP decoded as latin-1, causing mojibake in the Japanese comment text. The program is clearly part of the open-source ORCA medical receipt system (JMA, Japan).
